author: unknown
content:
Its wild how its 2026 and the host player can still instantly fail a deep archimedian, with no chance of host migration, by force exiting the 2nd or 3rd stage just after loading.
Decided to do a deep archimedian after a few months cause i was bored and i was taken by surprise when the 3rd mission loaded and the host said something in chat that i could not read fast enough and everyone got hit with a mission failed.

Im giving the guy the benefit of doubt that an emergency showed up and it was not an act of griefing, but the big thing is how you can still cause a forced mission failure like that.

By now i would have hoped DE could at least shove you into a solo instance so you actually have at least a chance of finishing the mission solo rather than just boot you back to your base of operations
